batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground vulnerabilities page v0.9.0
batch_node.description: The /playground/vulnerabilities page (four cards, three charts, a table of open vulnerabilities and two tables of affected components) with a drill-in page per component, a short older vulnerability page, and the CVE page that explains one vulnerability: the answer first, how bad and how urgent, what it is, where it affects us, then the details and sources. Everything reads Searches over the compliance_core vulnerability, finding and scanner nodes; nothing names a scanner, a node id or a value.

node.name: Open Findings
node.description: Open findings that concern a vulnerability.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-open
node.description: Open findings that concern a vulnerability.

node.name: On The CISA Exploited List
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on the CISA KEV catalog.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-kev
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

query: MATCH (f:compliance_core__compliance_finding)-[:CONCERNS_COMPLIANCE_VULNERABILITY__compliance_core]->(v:compliance_core__compliance_vulnerability) WHERE f.data.status = "open" AND v.data.kev = true

node.name: Closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open: fixed or dismissed at the source.

query: RETURN v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, COUNT(f) AS n

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities top-components
node.description: The components with the most open findings, banded High (CVSS 7 and up), Medium and Low, for the stacked chart. A module Search because Gryphon has no conditional counts; the missing capability is several filtered counts in one query. The chart sorts by total and keeps ten.

exclude_types.description: Node types that carry findings but are systems, not components; the repository carries every alert.

node.name: Severity By Age
node.description: Each dot is a vulnerability with an open finding: when it was published, against its CVSS score; a bigger dot has more findings, and its number is the count.

config.aria_label: Vulnerabilities with an open finding, by publication time and CVSS score

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities risk-map
node.description: One row per vulnerability with an open finding: its score, publication time and how many findings it has.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.published_at AS published, COUNT(f) AS n

node.name: Vulnerability
node.description: One vulnerability's score, vector, exploitation signals and description in two tables. Older than the CVE page, which shows all of this and the components and systems too; nothing links here now.

node.name: Component
node.description: One component: its type and open findings, every vulnerability it carries and the systems where it runs. Open it from a vulnerability on a component page.

node.name: Vulnerabilities
node.description: What is open, how severe, and what carries it: three cards, three charts, then every open vulnerability and every affected component. Click a vulnerability for its CVE record and a component for what it carries.

node.name: CVE Dashboard
node.description: The CVE record of the selected vulnerability, read from the local vuln-mosaic stores: exploitation, scores, products, references. Needs the vuln-mosaic plugin on the stack.

node.name: CVE
node.description: One vulnerability explained: how bad it scores, whether it is being exploited and how likely that is, what it is, the components and systems here that carry it, then the record's details and sources. Open it from a vulnerability on the Vulnerabilities or Component page.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.title AS title, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.cvss_version AS version, v.data.cvss_source AS scored_by, v.data.kev AS kev, v.data.published_at AS published

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

query: MATCH (c)-[:CARRIES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING__compliance_core]->(f:compliance_core__compliance_finding)-[:CONCERNS_COMPLIANCE_VULNERABILITY__compliance_core]->(v:compliance_core__compliance_vulnerability) WHERE v.data.vuln_id = $vuln_id AND f.data.status = "open" AND c.entity_type != "github_core__github_repository"

node.description: Vulnerabilities in the grid classed CWE-506, Embedded Malicious Code.

node.description: Vulnerabilities in the grid whose CWE list contains CWE-506.

query: MATCH (c)-[:CARRIES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING__compliance_core]->(f:compliance_core__compliance_finding)-[:CONCERNS_COMPLIANCE_VULNERABILITY__compliance_core]->(v:compliance_core__compliance_vulnerability) WHERE v.data.cwes CONTAINS "CWE-506" AND c.entity_type != "github_core__github_repository"
